atomicity_rules: Claim creation and durable dispatch intent are one local database transaction.
A worker may not mutate unless its fencing_token equals the lane's current fencing token.
Owner-head invalidation increments the fencing token before any replacement claim can be created.
A terminal transition and lease release are one local database transaction.
Git is an audit/evidence export target, not the live lease/queue database.
claim_lifecycle_rules: READY -> CLAIMED requires exact current owner head, one live claim maximum per lane, a globally unique idempotency key and a monotonically increasing fencing token.
CLAIMED -> DISPATCH_INTENT is committed atomically with the claim.
DISPATCH_INTENT -> DISPATCHED records the external/local execution identity; duplicate acknowledgement with the same identity is idempotent and conflicting acknowledgement fails closed.
RUNNING, HEARTBEAT and PROGRESS require the exact live lease_id, delegation_id, objective_id, control_head, idempotency_key and fencing_token.
COMPLETED, BLOCKED or STALE releases only the exact live claim and fences all stale workers.
Owner-head change during a claim terminalizes that claim as STALE and increments the lane fence before successor selection.
SUCCESSOR_BOUND follows a terminal/reconciliation boundary and creates a new READY generation; it never reuses the prior idempotency key.
SHIFT_CLOSE is invalid while a mutation-capable lease remains live.
retry_rules: Every new retry is a durable RETRY event; retry counts may not exist only inside free-form evidence.
retry_budget is an integer from 1 through max_retry_budget and attempt never exceeds retry_budget.
CIRCUIT_OPEN requires the immediately applicable dependency retry budget to be exhausted.
CIRCUIT_HALF_OPEN requires prior CIRCUIT_OPEN; CIRCUIT_CLOSED requires prior CIRCUIT_HALF_OPEN.
An open circuit blocks only that dependency; the lane continues through dependency-valid fallback work when available.
recovery_rules: Supervisor restart reconstructs live work from the transactional database before reading Git audit exports.
An expired lease is terminalized STALE before any replacement claim is admitted.
A pending dispatch intent survives process and machine restart and is reconciled before redispatch.
Missed GitHub schedules do not prevent work because the supervisor uses wall-clock shift state and immediate restart catch-up.
Unknown external dispatch outcome is reconciled by dispatch_id/idempotency_key before another mutation-capable execution is permitted.
authority_boundary: This schema controls execution reliability only. It grants no product, A-01, native, author, private, publication, promotion or production authority.
